title: Chief AI/ML Architect — Causal AI and Enterprise Decision Operating Systems
summary: A structured blueprint covering causal inference, causal graphs, enterprise knowledge systems, agentic decisioning, deterministic controls, platform architecture, and a 90-day evidence-building sequence.

verification.notes: Supplied master blueprint. It is a learning and architecture corpus, not evidence of personal production delivery. Section-level canonical records are generated from this source for retrieval and study.

claims: A chief-level causal AI architecture must connect theory, algorithms, implementation, enterprise application, validation, and leadership decisions.
A causal decision operating system should connect observations to causal models, interventions, counterfactuals, deterministic controls, approved actions, and post-action verification.
Causal discovery outputs candidate structures and must not be treated as proven causal evidence without assumptions, domain review, and validation.
Knowledge graphs, causal models, evidence, and model versions should be connected while remaining distinct system boundaries.

causal_claims.subject: Enterprise Observation
assumptions: Observations have usable provenance and the action boundary is governed.

causal_claims.subject: Causal Discovery Output
assumptions: Discovery assumptions, domain constraints, and refutation results are retained.

causal_claims.subject: Causal Claim
assumptions: Claims can be reviewed, refuted, superseded, or restricted to a context.
